column3: Manami route ・ The Couple Forever After
A day passes with nothing happening. Warm and cozy, yet somehow unsatisfying.
You know, this tea is reeeeally delicious～
Oh? Is it different than usual?
Reaaaaaally yummy tea. I ordered it～
It complements this tea cake perfectly. I wanted to try drinking it with Kyou-chan～
Every day was just a little different. yeah, just one little bit.
On Manami's finger, was a ring with a subtle glimmer.
We always went home together on that forked road.
This is... the state of the "future" Tamura Manami and Kousaka Kyousuke.
...Mmm, it does suit each other nicely, it's so good.
This cake, you see, is something my grandpa thought up a long time ago.
Yes. The shape is kinda cute, right?
Huh, I thought maybe this was your idea.
Hehe, you see, when grandpa was young... He made this cake to present it to grandma.
Ohh, grandpa... he was quite devoted.
Wasn't he? That's why I also wanted to eat it together with Kyou-chan.
Yeah, that's great! The two of us together!
Eeehhh? A-Are you unhappy with it?!
Starting from long ago, I kept thinking that...
If it was all over, decades later on a day like this one... Then...
Still, this was a bit off the mark.
A continuous, unending happiness, that's what it is.
